howToUse: Second fixture file, beside crisis-fixtures.json (which stays the 2026-10-14 shared set). Holds every phrase from the other versions of the gate (Veterans At Ease cloud branch 9249ebf, Connecting the Dots verify-mike inline lists) that crisis-fixtures.json lacks, plus the 2026-11-24 red-team (round 1, and round 2 which was held out and run once before any tuning). Run each text exactly as written. Every positive must return the crisis reply, except positives marked knownMiss: those are gaps the gate does not catch yet, reported on every run; when one starts firing, delete its knownMiss flag. Every negative must not return it. Identical copy in both apps.

I served two tours in Iraq with the 1st Cavalry Division, 2004 and 2007, mostly out of Camp Taji and FOB Falcon. We burned trash in open pits every day and the smoke sat on the camp most nights. I filed for tinnitus and lower back strain in 2012 and got 10 percent for each. My C&P examiner spent about eight minutes with me and never looked at my service treatment records. Since then my breathing has gotten worse and my primary care doctor at the CBOC ordered a pulmonary function test. I am trying to figure out whether the PACT Act covers constrictive bronchiolitis and what evidence I should gather. My VSO at the DAV said I should get buddy statements from guys in my platoon who remember the pits. I also have sleep problems and my wife says I stop breathing at night, so I want to ask about a sleep study.
